description: SIDE EFFECT: publishes a comment, in the signed-in person's name, in the public discussion of one chapter, where other readers see it. Use only when the person asks to post it, with words they approved. Optional `quote` pins it to a passage (copy it exactly from the chapter); `reply_to` answers a comment from get_chapter_discussion. Every comment goes through the site's moderation: one it holds is shown to the author only, and the result says so. Needs sign-in with the mikefluff:discuss scope and a chapter the person may read. For a private remark to the author use send_note_to_author.

body.description: The comment, as the person wants it published.

lang.description: Edition (language of the text): each has its own discussion.

quote.description: An exact passage from the chapter the comment is about.

reply_to.description: Id of the comment this answers.

name: post_comment
title: Comment in a chapter's discussion
